newsitem.title: CANADA: Newbridge eases further in follow-through.
newsitem.headline: Newbridge eases further in follow-through.

text.p: Newbridge Networks Corp shares eased in early trading on Monday in what analysts called a follow-through from last week's post-earnings dip.
Newbridge shares were off 1.15 at 39.65 in brisk trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange and down 7/8 at 29-5/8 on the New York Stock Exchange.

"I am not aware of anything incremental today. We did lower our numbers late last week -- we lowered our earnings estimates slightly. So it may just be a reaction to that or to something someone else said," said Nikos Theodosopoulos, an analyst at UBS Securities.
Newbridge posted a profit of US$0.26 per share, one U.S. penny shy of consensus estimates, and while many analysts reaffirmed their faith in the company's future, some raised red flags.
Last week, Alex. Brown downgraded Newbridge to a buy from a strong buy.
-- Sarah Edmonds, Reuters Toronto Bureau (416) 941-8100, E-mail sarah.edmonds@reuters.com
